name: ThermoWeave Boots ASD Edition
description:
The ThermoWeave boots receive a special dual-coat to achieve the same fire-rating as the rest of the suit. The boots also have reinforced high ankle support and ultra durable, anti-slip outsoles.

Worn by employees who require an extra level of protection in their field, the ASD Edition showcases the reds and greens of the ASD branding.
